titre: Master's in Smart & Green Building · BMS, energy and connected buildings
accroche: I design, manage and optimise smart buildings: from the PLC on site to the energy dashboard.
presentation: Four years of work-study in BMS at Caldya gave me solid field experience: EcoStruxure programming, commissioning, metering and client relations. Now in the second year of a Master's in Smart & Green Building engineering management at ESIEE-IT, I take a broader view: I lead projects, connect BMS, IoT and energy data, and help buildings comply with the French BACS decree.
apropos: My path has been a steady rise in skills, always on a work-study basis: STI2D baccalaureate, BTS in electrical engineering, professional Bachelor's in home automation, then a Master's in Smart & Green Building engineering management at ESIEE-IT.

At Caldya GTB since 2022, I learned the trade on site and in the design office: programming on Schneider EcoStruxure Building Operation, commissioning equipment such as Belimo controls, checking electricity metering on commercial and logistics sites, writing technical reports and prospecting around the BACS decree.

My Master's adds the big picture and leadership: project manager of a multidisciplinary team (BMS, AI, cybersecurity), project management, energy data and IoT. My goal: to design and run buildings that are more efficient, smarter and compliant with regulations.
